name: engineering-board
description: Git-committed pattern intelligence for engineering agents. Engineering Board clusters findings, preserves root-cause evidence, and retrieves relevant repository memory through 19 MCP tools.

interface.shortDescription: Give engineering agents durable pattern memory
interface.longDescription: Engineering Board records findings in reviewable Markdown, clusters related evidence, preserves root-cause hypotheses and outcomes, and retrieves the most relevant memory before an agent changes code.
defaultPrompt: Initialize Engineering Board in this repository and explain the memory workflow.
Show the patterns and root-cause hypotheses that are relevant to my current task.
Capture this finding and connect it to related failures before we fix it.
